name: Herbert D. Hostetter
role: Pittsburgh visitor at Howard Eaton's ranch
bio: Herbert D. Hostetter of Pittsburgh made yearly visits to Howard Eaton's ranch, staying several weeks in 1884 and again in the fall of 1885. In October 1885 he cut his foot and went to Glendive for medical care.

moments.label: Cut his foot and went to Glendive for care
